finding: The study identified two main infant microbiota clusters driven by Bacteroidaceae and Clostridiaceae, associated with birth mode and differing in biosynthetic and carbohydrate degradation pathways, with some infants showing persistent depletion in Bacteroides despite vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Vaginally delivered infants showed a higher prevalence of the Bacteroides-dominant cluster, while C-section delivered infants were more likely to have a Clostridiaceae-dominant microbiota.
